title: Goodman Recalls Air Handlers Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The pull-out disconnects may not disable power to the air handler, posing an electrical shock hazard to individuals servicing the units. Units: About 210,000 (in addition, 20 were sold in Canada).

title: Kids II Recalls Oball Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The clear plastic disc on the outside of the ball can break, releasing small beads, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 680,000 (in addition, about 17,000 were sold in Canada).

title: One World Technologies Recalls Electric Blowers Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The plastic fan inside the blower can break causing the fan blades to be discharged from either end of the blower tube, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 121,000 (In addition, about 1,900 were sold in Canada and 1,100 in Mexico).

title: Polaris Recalls RZR and GENERAL Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The vehicle engine can misfire and the temperatures of the exhaust and nearby components can get too hot and cause the components to melt, and/or a contaminated brake master cylinder may cause unintended brake drag, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 13,500 (The RZR Turbo and RZR 900 and 100

title: Philips Lighting Expands Recall of Metal Halide Lamps Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: The outer bulbs can shatter, resulting in hot internal pieces of glass falling from the lamps, posing fire and laceration hazards. Units: About 256,000 (in addition, about 87,000 were previously recalled on May 24, 2016)..

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Glass Knobs Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass knobs can break while in use, posing a risk of laceration to users from broken pieces. Units: About 363,000 units in the U.S. (in addition, about 41,000 units in Canada).

title: Advanced Sports International Recalls Fuji Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The rear wheel freehub can slip while pedaling, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 650.

title: Battery Chargers for XBOX ONE Video Game Controllers Recalled by Performance Designed Products Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The battery chargers can overheat and damage the XBOX ONE video game controller, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 121,000 in the U.S. (In addition, about 7,250 were sold in Canada and 2,560 in Mexico).

title: LIVLY Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's robes and pajama sets fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,200.

title: R.W. Beckett Recalls Fuel Oil Valves Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The safety valve stem does not properly seal and shut off the flow of fuel, allowing fuel to leak and posing a fire hazard. Units: About 18,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Bistro Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolts and/or nuts connecting the chair legs to the chair base can loosen and make the chair unstable, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,300 sets and 700 individual chairs in the U.S. (in addition, about 760 sets and 40 individual chairs in Canada)..

title: RDG Global Recalls Girls’ Hooded Sweatshirts Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Nordstrom
summary: The hooded sweatshirts have a drawstring in the hood, which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation or an entanglement hazard to children. Units

title: Craftsman Portable Table Saws Made by Rexon Recalled Due to Laceration and Impact Injury Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Sears
summary: The table saw's stand can collapse unexpectedly, posing laceration and impact injury hazards to the operator. Units: About 46,000.

title: L.L. Bean Recalls Snowshoes Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The plastic material on the snowshoes can weaken and break during use, posing a fall hazard to users. Units: About 3,000.

title: Black+Decker Portable Table Saws Made by Rexon Recalled Due to Laceration and Impact Injury Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The table saw stand can collapse unexpectedly, posing laceration and impact injury hazards to the operator. Units: About 400.

title: BlenderBottle Recalls Whiskware Glass Dressing Shaker Bottles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The bottom of the glass dressing shaker bottle can break when the metal agitator strikes the glass bottom, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 48,000 (in addition, about 800 were sold in Canada).

title: humangear Recalls Bottle Caps Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The capCAP can leak, dislodge or come off, posing a burn hazard to consumers when the bottles are used to hold hot liquids. Units: About 61,000 (in addition, about 360 were sold in Canada).

title: Infant Caps Recalled by Sock and Accessory Brands Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The button on the top of the infant cap can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 14,500 (in addition, about 50 were sold in Canada).

title: Juratoys Recalls Toy Trolleys Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The toy trolleys can tip backwards, posing an impact injury hazard to children. Units: About 9,900 (in addition about 640 were sold in Canada).

title: Target Recalls Magnetic Tic Tac Toe Games Due to Choking and Magnet Ingestion Hazards
summary: The magnets can come off the tic tac toe game pieces, posing a choking hazard. In addition, when two or more magnets are swallowed, they can link together inside the intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. title: Look Cycle Recalls Aerostems and Road Bikes Due to Fall, Crash Hazards
summary: The stainless steel clamp that secures the stem to the handlebars can corrode and break, posing a fall and crash hazard. Units: About 800.

title: SolarWorld Recalls Connectors Sold with Solar Panels Due to Electrical Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The connectors that are attached to the solar panels can develop microscopic cracks that allow moisture to leak into them while the system is producing electricity, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 97,000.

title: OPW Recalls Gas Station Hose Swivel Connectors Due to Fire, Explosion Hazards
summary: The swivel connectors can separate from the hose or nozzle of the gas station pump and cause fuel spillage, posing fire and explosion hazards. Units: About 824,000.

title: Haibike Recalls Electric Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The fork on the front wheel of the bicycles can rupture or break while in use, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 250 (in addition, 17 were sold in Canada).

title: Power Adapters Sold with LectroFan Sound Machines Recalled by ASTI Due to Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The casing on the power adapter can break when plugged into an electrical outlet, exposing its metal prongs, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 35,000.

title: Vecaro LifeStyle Recalls Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 500.

title: Wing Enterprises Recalls Little Giant Ladders Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ladder's locking pins/rung fasteners can fail, posing a fall hazard to consumers on the ladder. Units: About 37,000.

title: Discount School Supply Recalls Children's Waterproof Bibs Due to Suffocation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bib has a waterproof plastic backing that can separate from the terry cloth fabric, creating a suffocation hazard to children. Units: About 10,400 packages.

title: Polaris Recalls Sportsman 850 and 1000 All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The right side panel heat shield can melt, posing burn and fire hazards to riders. In addition, in 2015 Sportsman 1000 ATVs, the exhaust springs can stretch and damage the exhaust seal, which can result in exhaust leaks and pose burn and fire hazards. Units: About 19,200.
